## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `97dd3cb37b19efb826ef0ef2f0d21ddf819785dd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md (L34 pointer 「配额见 filing-gate.md」, L42), scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs (header rules ①–⑤, the batch gap 「守批量写间隔」 names), scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs (no per-fire count gate exists), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (filing-gate.md ceiling 68)

Inputs read: card #25498 body and all three comments (triage 6370333645, claim 6386358369, os-dev-report 6386558218); PR #25687 body, file list (one path) and the net diff against `main` at base `b2909fd4`; the 47 check-runs on the head — all completed, 30 success, 17 skipped, none failed (Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset all success). The PR thread carries no other comment.

### ① Derived judgments

Diff: one line of `filing-gate.md` 〈立卡门〉 (L34) rewritten in place, net 0 lines, 120 bytes before and after; file stays at 68 lines (ratchet ceiling 68, headroom 0, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1370`). No published schema, no runtime code, no accept-set: the only surface is the seat-facing filing rule.

- Per-fire count cap removed (一席每 fire 至多三张 → 每 fire 不限张数) — **right**. The maintainer's verbatim ask 「skills 需要立一张卡，去掉 只能提交3个issue 的限制。」 is fully met: at base `b2909fd4` the string `至多三张` lived only on this line (the other `三张` hits in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` are "three boards" at `seat-post-protocol.md:83`, `seat-lifecycle.md:77`, and a "third diverging card" at `lanes/server.md:34`); at the head the grep is empty. No script in `scripts/pm/` enforced a three-per-fire count (`issue-create.mjs` gates only prerequisite/rate-limit answers; `write-pace.mjs` counts writes per hour, not cards per fire), so no gate is left contradicting the rule — rule and enforcement stay one.
- QA/走查 exemption folded away (「QA/走查逐缺陷立不限张数」 dropped, 「逐缺陷各立一张、各过本门」 granted to every seat) — **right**. The clause had no other reader: `走查`/`walkthrough` in the filing sense occurs nowhere else under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`. Nothing the exemption granted is lost; it is now the general rule, and 「各过本门」 keeps every such card under the four-category gate and the four POST answers (L10–L25).
- Overflow fold targets (「超出折清单卡或座位贴」 → 「折清单卡可选、不强制」) — **right**. With no count cap there is no overflow, so the seat post as an overflow destination is moot; the seat post keeps its other homes untouched (L19 protocol observations and own mistakes, L36 the `User` read). List-card folding survives as an option, as the card asked.
- 「守批量间隔」 → 「守批量写间隔」 — **right**, and sharper: it names the mechanical object, `write-pace.mjs` rule ⑤ (batch mode: a caller creating N ≥ 5 objects announces it and the gap rises to 30 s fleet-wide) on top of rules ① (3 s min gap), ② (40 writes/hour, the 41st refused), ③ (back-off stop marker) and ④ (one write in flight). Rule ② is therefore still the mechanical ceiling behind 「不限张数」 — a seat filing more than the hour allows is refused by the throttle with a fold prescription, which is the ruling's intent (「截流应该要加」) carried by pacing rather than by a flat count. The `Batch-of:` audit line for ≥ 10 cards (L29) and the triage seat's ten-at-a-time cleanup (L35) are untouched.
- `配额:` label kept — **right**: `triage-duties.md:34` 「…理由判据与配额见 filing-gate.md」 still lands on a line that answers it; `triage-duties.md:42` 「无配额」 concerns observations never being filed and is unrelated.
- Card body framed the landing as Tier H (maintainer's authorized approval); the claim and the PR body correct it to Tier S (`.claude/**`, 达档复核在案后席位落地) — **right** per AGENTS.md's register tiering. Line is 120 bytes at the CJK width cap, 68/68 lines; the ratchet gate (Lint · PM dispatch-gates) is green on the head.

### ② Semver level

No changeset; label `skip-changeset`; Check Changeset success. `.claude/**` publishes nothing — no package, schema or CLI surface changes. **Matches.** `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the claim is **right**: no spec accept/declare set or `/meta` gate moves in either direction, so neither the declaration face nor the narrowing face applies; the review owed is the rules face (governed path), which this record is.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev `deviations` (3), each answered: (a) commit trailer in the model-free form `os-dev.md` prescribes rather than the harness reminder's model-named line — the repo's own instruction set outranks the harness reminder, accepted; (b) PR body carries AGENTS.md's session-URL footer only, avoiding a double footer — accepted; (c) no changeset on a `.claude/**`-only diff with `skip-changeset` declared at `pr_create` — accepted, see ②. `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: []` — nothing to escalate. `premise_still_valid: true` holds against the head (grep confirms). Dispatch mandate `TIER_DEFAULT` with the compensating `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before landing is this record. Check-runs: 47/47 completed, none in_progress, none failed. Fork check: head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, not a fork.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-25498-filing-gate-quota`
Reviewed-by: `session_014FZ3TJucS1L7BdMe5DAzXC`

**VERDICT: PASS**
